description: Wireless Bluetooth over-ear headphones with rechargeable battery and noise cancellation
notes: Heading 8518 covers headphones/earphones (GRI 1). 8518.30 is headphones/earphones; 8518.30.20 is the non-line-telephony bin commonly used for consumer Bluetooth headphones.

description: Men's short-sleeve crew-neck cotton t-shirt, knitted, white, size large
notes: 6109 is the heading for knitted t-shirts. 6109.10 is the cotton subheading. 10-digit varies by exact color/construction (e.g., 6109.10.0004 for certain all-white men's).

description: USB-C to USB-C charging cable, 6 ft, braided nylon, PD 100W rated
notes: Insulated electric conductor fitted with connectors; voltage <=1000V. 8544.42 covers fitted-with-connectors; .90 is the residual 'Other' bin.

description: Lithium-ion 18650 rechargeable battery pack, 5 cells in series with BMS
notes: Heading 8507 covers electric storage batteries. 8507.60 is lithium-ion specifically. 10-digit suffix distinguishes pack vs cell.

description: Men's full-grain leather belt, 1.5 inch wide, with metal pin buckle
notes: 4203 is articles of apparel of leather. 4203.30 specifically covers belts and bandoliers (with or without buckles).

description: Stainless steel double-wall vacuum-insulated water bottle, 750 ml, with leakproof lid
notes: Heading 9617 covers vacuum flasks and other vacuum vessels. 9617.00.10 = capacity not exceeding 1 L. Ambiguous with 7323.93 (stainless steel household articles) if vacuum function is not the essential character.

description: Clear silicone protective case that snaps onto an iPhone, with raised camera bezel
notes: Genuinely contested in CBP practice. Snap-on silicone covers go to 3926.99 in some rulings (essential character: plastic article) and 4202.32 in others (container by name in heading 4202).

description: Bamboo end-grain cutting board, 18 in x 12 in x 1.5 in, food-safe finish
notes: Post-2022 HS revision: 4419.11 is the specific 6-digit line for 'Bread boards, chopping boards and similar boards' of bamboo. Earlier eval used 4419.19 incorrectly.

description: LED desk lamp with adjustable arm, USB-powered, painted aluminum base
notes: Post-2022 HS revision: 9405.21 is the specific 6-digit subheading for 'Electric table, desk, bedside or floor-standing lamps designed for use solely with light-emitting diode (LED) light sources'. Earlier eval used 9405.20 which is for non-LED-only.

description: Rechargeable sonic electric toothbrush with charging stand and replacement heads
notes: 8509 covers electromechanical domestic appliances with self-contained electric motor. Electric toothbrushes are classified under 8509.80 'Other appliances'.

description: Glazed earthenware coffee mug, 12 oz, printed logo
notes: 6912 = ceramic tableware not of porcelain/china. The schedule has a specific 8-digit line for 'Mugs and other steins' of earthenware: 6912.00.41.

description: Polypropylene food storage container with snap-on lid, 1 liter, microwave safe
notes: 3924 = tableware/kitchenware of plastics. 3924.10 is the tableware/kitchenware subheading. Heavily ambiguous with 3923.21/3923.29 (articles for the conveyance/packing of goods) — distinction hinges on intended household-reuse vs single-use packaging.

description: Smartwatch with heart-rate sensor, GPS, color touchscreen, Bluetooth and Wi-Fi
notes: Recent CBP rulings classify smartwatches as data-communication devices under 8517.62 (machines for reception/transmission of data) rather than as wristwatches. Heavily ambiguous with 9102.12 (battery-powered wristwatches with optoelectronic display).

description: TPE foam yoga exercise mat, 6 mm thick, 72 in x 24 in, textured non-slip surface
notes: CBP has consistently classified yoga mats as floor coverings of plastics under 3918.90 (e.g., recent NY rulings). Ambiguous with 9506.91 (articles for general physical exercise) — taxpayers often try 9506 first.

description: Flat woven nylon dog collar with plastic snap buckle, padded interior, 1 in wide
notes: 4201 covers saddlery and harness for any animal. 4201.00.30 is the specific line for dog leashes, collars, muzzles and harnesses. Ambiguous with 6307.90 (other made-up textile articles) for purely textile items, but the use as animal harness puts it in 4201.

description: Frozen pork dumplings, ready to cook, sealed plastic bag, 1 lb
notes: 1902 covers pasta and stuffed pasta products including dumplings. 1902.20 is the stuffed-pasta subheading regardless of cooking method. 10-digit suffix .0040 is the common 'other' bin.

description: Clear pressed-glass candle holder, 4 in tall, machine-made for indoor decoration
notes: 7013.99.35 is the specific US 8-digit line for 'Votive-candle holders'. A candle holder used for indoor decoration is more specifically a votive-candle holder than 7013.99.50 (residual 'Other'). Updated from previous eval which used the residual line.

description: Jewelry organizer box with felt-lined compartments, outer shell of cast polyester resin
notes: 4202 covers jewelry boxes specifically by name. 4202.99 is residual outer surface. Ambiguous with 3926.90 (other articles of plastics) when the resin is the essential character — but the 'jewelry box' designation in 4202 typically wins under GRI 1.

description: Stainless steel chef's knife, 8 in fixed blade, riveted plastic handle
notes: 8211 = knives with cutting blades. 8211.92 = other fixed-blade knives. .40 covers handles of rubber or plastic; the kitchen/butcher 10-digit suffix varies by blade length.

description: Aluminum 24 ft extension ladder, 300 lb load capacity, anti-slip rungs
notes: 7616 = other articles of aluminum. 7616.99 is the residual subheading and .51 is the commonly used 'other articles, not enumerated' US line. CBP rulings consistently put aluminum extension ladders here.

description: Rubber dishwashing gloves, latex-free nitrile, women's medium, lined, household use
notes: Material-vs-function: 'gloves' suggests apparel chap 61/62 but 4015 covers articles of apparel of vulcanized rubber. 4015.19.05 = household.

description: Stainless steel kitchen scissors with plastic handles, 8 in overall length
notes: Material-vs-function: 'stainless steel' pulls toward chap 73 but scissors are named in heading 8213 (chap 82, tools). 8213.00.30 is the US line for retail-priced household scissors > $1.75/dozen.

description: Wireless computer mouse with USB-A receiver dongle and one AA battery, ergonomic shape
notes: Misleading colloquial: 'mouse' is not chap 1 (live animals); chap 84 input units. 8471.60.20 is the common CBP bin for combined input/output units; some rulings use 8471.60.80 (other input units) — accept any chap 84 hit as right.

description: Non-slip mouse pad with cloth top and natural rubber base, 8.5 in x 10 in, stitched edges
notes: Material-vs-function: GRI 3(b) — essential character is the rubber base. Heavily ambiguous with 8473.30 (parts/accessories of ADP machines); recent CBP rulings split between the two.

description: Padded tablet case for 10-inch iPad with magnetic snap closure, polyurethane outer, microfiber interior
notes: Misleading colloquial: 'tablet' tempts chap 84 (computers); 4202 names cases by article. 4202.92.91 is outer-surface-of-plastic-sheeting. Ambiguous with 3926.99 if essential character argued as plastic.

description: Acetaminophen 500 mg tablets, 100-count bottle, retail OTC pain reliever
notes: Misleading colloquial: 'tablets' isn't computer tablets (8471); 3004 covers medicaments in measured doses for retail. 3004.90 is residual (not antibiotics/vitamins/hormones).

description: Cordless drill set: 18 V drill driver, two Li-ion battery packs, charger, 30 drill/driver bits, all in fitted plastic carrying case
notes: GRI 3(b) — composite/set put up for retail; essential character is the drill, classified under 8467.21. Bits, batteries, charger and case follow under GRI 5 / 3(b).

description: Women's leather handbag, full-grain top-grain leather, metal hardware, fabric lining, magnetic snap, 12 in wide
notes: GRI 3(b) composite: essential character is the leather outer surface (4202.21). 4202.21.60 = leather handbag valued not over $20 per CBP common-value tier; .90 if valued over $20. Accept either 8-digit bin.

description: Mixed nut assortment: salted roasted cashews, almonds, peanuts, in resealable plastic jar, 16 oz
notes: GRI 3(b)/3(c) — mixture without a single essential-character component goes to 2008.19 'Other, including mixtures' under heading 2008 (fruits/nuts otherwise prepared).

description: Disassembled cycling helmet kit in retail box: outer shell, foam insert, chinstrap with buckle, ready for end-user assembly
notes: GRI 2(a) — incomplete/unassembled article classified as the finished article (cycling helmet, safety headgear, 6506.10). .60 is the residual US 8-digit for non-athletic/racing helmets.

description: Plastic Christmas tree, artificial spruce, 6 ft, in cardboard storage box, retail
notes: Chapter-note decisive: chap 39 note 2 excludes 'articles of chapter 95' (festive articles); chap 95 note 1 includes festive articles. Article is festive Christmas decoration; 9505.10 names Christmas articles specifically.

description: Imitation pearl necklace, white plastic beads on metal chain with silver-plated lobster-claw clasp
notes: Chapter-note decisive: chap 39 note 2(s) states 'This chapter does not cover: ... (s) Imitation jewelry (heading 7117)'. Plastic beads strung as jewelry are imitation jewelry under 7117, not chap 39.

description: Plastic LED Halloween pumpkin tabletop decoration, battery-operated, festive seasonal item
notes: Chapter-note decisive: chap 39 note 2 excludes 'articles of chapter 95'. 9505 covers 'festive, carnival or other entertainment articles'. Halloween pumpkin decoration goes to 9505.90 (other than Christmas).

description: Coffee gift set: 12 oz bag of roasted ground arabica coffee + ceramic stoneware mug + 6 vanilla biscotti cookies, presented in cardboard giftbox for retail
notes: GRI 3(b) set put up for retail. Essential character is the coffee (drives the gift's purpose and is the highest-value consumable). Coffee classified under 0901.21 (roasted, not decaffeinated). Per CBP HQ rulings on coffee gift sets.

description: Bath bomb gift set: 6 lavender-scented bath bombs + 30 ml bottle of essential oil + 100 g bar of glycerin soap, all in a mesh drawstring pouch, retail
notes: GRI 3(b) set put up for retail. Bath bombs give essential character (primary product by count and intended use). 3307.30 = 'Perfumed bath salts and other bath preparations'; .50 is the US residual 'Other' line.

description: Bicycle puncture repair kit: 6 vulcanized rubber tire patches + plastic tire levers + 2 g tube of rubber cement, in cloth zip pouch
notes: GRI 3(b) set; essential character is the patches (consumable that performs the repair). 4008.21 = plates/sheets/strip of non-cellular vulcanized rubber. Discussed in the v2 prompt's worked example.

description: Women's leather handbag, full-grain top-grain leather outer, fabric lining, magnetic snap closure, gold-tone metal hardware, 12 in wide. Wholesale unit value: $24.99 USD
notes: Value-tier test. 4202.21 (handbags of leather) splits at $20: 4202.21.60 = valued not over $20 each, 4202.21.90 = valued over $20 each. At $24.99 → 4202.21.90.

description: Stainless steel measuring cup set, nested 4-piece (1/4, 1/3, 1/2, 1 cup), mirror-polished, riveted handles
notes: GRI 1 control. 7323 = table/kitchen/household articles of iron or steel. 7323.93 = of stainless steel. .00 is the only 8-digit US line for stainless steel kitchenware.

description: Men's winter scarf, knitted, 100% merino wool, 12 in x 60 in, charcoal grey
notes: GRI 1 control. 6117 = made-up clothing accessories, knitted or crocheted. 6117.10 = shawls, scarves, mufflers etc. .20 is the US line for wool (vs man-made fibers).

description: Cut and engraved glass drinking tumbler, machine-pressed, 12 fl oz capacity, lead-free crystal. Wholesale unit value: $0.75 USD
notes: Value-tier test. 7013.37 = other drinking glasses (not stemware, not lead crystal). The US 8-digit lines are value-tiered: .05 ≤$0.30, .20 $0.30<x≤$3.00, .30 $3.00<x≤$5.00, .50 >$5.00. At $0.75 → 7013.37.20.
